profile.subtitleJa: ヨセフ家が攻め上った山地の町
profile.summaryJa: ヨセフ家が主の助けを受けて攻め上った町として記されます。

facts.textJa: 本文はベテルの以前の町名をルズとし、ヨセフ家が斥候を送ったと記します。
デボラはラマとベテルの間のナツメヤシの木の下で裁きを行いました。
イスラエルの人々はベテルで神に伺い、ベニヤミンとの戦いの先鋒を尋ねました。
敗戦後、イスラエルの人々は再びベテルに集まり、断食と献げ物をしました。
戦闘の記述では、ベテルとギブアへ上る道が描かれています。
民はベテルで夕方まで神の前に座り、声を上げて泣きました。
ベテルはシロへ上る道との位置関係を示す地名として記されます。

profile.modernLocationJa: 中央山地、エルサレム北方の古代遺跡に対応するとされます。古代の町域と現代のベイティンの村域は区別されます。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 士師記1:22でヨセフ家が攻め上った町として初出します。
profile.locationNoteJa: 地図上の位置は未確定です。表示される場合は従来資料の参考候補です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the LORD was with them.
The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)
She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
The children of Israel arose, went up to Bethel, and asked counsel of God. They asked, “Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?” The LORD said, “Judah first.”

Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until evening; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

The children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to strike and kill of the people as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah, in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.

They said, “Behold, there is a feast of the LORD from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”
